app.name: Regex Tester
app.description: Test JavaScript regular expressions live: highlighted matches, groups, flags, replacements and explanations.

flags.label: Flags
flags.d: Indices: report where each group matched
flags.g: Global: find every match, not just the first
flags.m: Multiline: ^ and $ match at line breaks
flags.s: Dot all: . also matches line breaks
flags.v: Unicode sets: set operations in classes
flags.y: Sticky: match only where the last match ended

status.timeout: Stopped: the expression took longer than {{seconds}} s (probably catastrophic backtracking).
status.tooLong: The test text is longer than {{count}} characters.

text.label: Test text
text.highlightLimit: Only the first 200,000 characters are highlighted.

matches.truncated: Only the first {{count}} matches are listed.

replace.label: Replacement
replace.hint: $1, $<name>, $& (the match), $` and $' (before and after it), $$ for $

email.name: Email address
email.description: A practical pattern for addresses in text (not every valid RFC 5322 address)

phone.name: Phone number
phone.description: Digits with spaces, dots, dashes or parentheses

slug.name: URL slug
slug.description: Lowercase words joined by dashes, one per line

duplicateWords.name: Repeated words
duplicateWords.description: A word immediately written twice, with a backreference

trailingSpace.name: Trailing whitespace
trailingSpace.description: Spaces and tabs at the end of lines

explain.nonWord: Any character except a word character
explain.namedBackreference: The same text as the group “{{name}}”
explain.property: A character with the Unicode property {{name}}
explain.notProperty: A character without the Unicode property {{name}}
explain.nonCapturing: A group that does not capture
explain.lookahead: Followed by (not part of the match):
explain.lookbehind: Preceded by (not part of the match):
explain.start: Start of the text (or line, with m)
explain.end: End of the text (or line, with m)
explain.any: Any character (except line breaks, unless s)
explain.zeroOrMore: Zero or more times, as many as possible
explain.zeroOrMoreLazy: Zero or more times, as few as possible
explain.oneOrMore: One or more times, as many as possible
explain.oneOrMoreLazy: One or more times, as few as possible
explain.atLeast_one: At least {{count}} time, as many as possible
explain.atLeast_other: At least {{count}} times, as many as possible
explain.atLeastLazy_one: At least {{count}} time, as few as possible
explain.atLeastLazy_other: At least {{count}} times, as few as possible
explain.between: Between {{min}} and {{max}} times, as many as possible
explain.betweenLazy: Between {{min}} and {{max}} times, as few as possible
